text: Whoa! We zoomed way in... and it looks exactly like the whole thing again!
After just five steps, only about one quarter is left. Keep going forever, and it's almost nothing... but it's still a triangle!
No stopping rule? Then it goes on forever... and ever... and ever... and ever...
It's a cat, holding a picture of a cat, holding a picture of a cat, holding a picture of a cat...
Challenge! At which step did the filled part first drop below one half?
Step three! Twenty-seven sixty-fourths is less than thirty-two sixty-fourths, and that's one half.
Bonus challenge! About how much would be left after ten steps?
About one sixteenth! A quarter of a quarter. Tiny!
